link.title: JSON in Bitbybit
link.description: Read and change JSON data in a Bitbybit script: parse text into values, read a property, find values anywhere in a document with JSONPath, set them on a copy and write the result back as text. JSON is how a model takes its sizes from a configurator, a file or a web service, and these pages show it driving a part in Rete, Blockly and TypeScript.
